verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an observability platform that stores logs, traces and LLM spans, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, retention filters, or data-deletion APIs or settings. The sensitive-data evaluation flag (datadog-docs-21) is an adjacent detection feature, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
